heroHeadline: Guinness Record: 47,460 Mangroves Planted in 24 Hours in Kenya; Panama and Tonga Launch New Reforestation Drives
heroSubtitle: Antoine Moses set a Guinness World Record on May 1 by planting 47,460 mangrove propagules in 24 hours at Tudor Creek, Mombasa, under Kenya's 15 Billion Tree Growing Programme. Panama's Ministry of Environment launched its 2026 national reforestation program targeting 1,000+ hectares of degraded watersheds, while UNDP-backed community groups in Tonga pursue 200,000 mangroves across Tongatapu and Vava'u. In Minnesota, St. Louis County began post-fire reforestation at the Munger Shaw site with 40,000 pine seedlings — part of a 350,000-seedling campaign for 2026.
footerNote: Data sourced from UNEP, FAO, UNCCD, IUCN, WRI Global Forest Watch, INPE, and Tier 2 science outlets. Pledge figures reflect commitments; verified restoration is substantially lower.
